d.ko: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!
d.en: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!
d.zh: 《我地麻》是一款以麻将为灵感并结合了麻将基础玩法的卡牌构筑肉鸽游戏，用你手中的麻将构筑出强大的番型组合、胡出难以想象的超高分数、针对Boss特点形成独特的制胜策略吧！
